sources.ref: Owner direction 2026-10-17 (v15): relabel the check-in from time pressure to workload (1=light, 7=heavy)

notes: v2 (2026-10-18, owner direction): subjective felt-workload reframe — question 'How heavy does your current workload feel right now?', anchors 'Very light'/'Overwhelming'. Equal objective crate counts made bare 'workload' read objective; felt strain is the intended construct.

v15 (2026-10-17): workload framing of the pressure check-in. Identical in both TP arms; only the displayed teammate values differ (arm manipulation). New artifact id so the 'pressure' naming stays on the v14-era lineage it describes.
Exact wording drafted by Devin for owner review during internal eval; structure and 1..7 scale anchors are the approved part.

body.question: How heavy does your current workload feel right now?
body.note: Your rating will be visible to your teammates. Your teammates are answering the same question.
body.reveal_note: These ratings will stay visible above the team chat.
